The '''Kwymar Suppressions''' described a series of attacks made by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to subjugate planets in the [[Kwymar sector/Legends|Kwymar sector]] in [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]].

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
A conflict in the [[Kwymar sector/Legends|Kwymar sector]] was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars Miniatures Battles]]'', p. 82. The Kwymar Suppressions were expanded in the miniature scenarios ''[[The Hunt Within: Valance's Tale]]'' by author [[Jason Fry]] who also named the campaign. Several battles from the ''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]'' and other previous sources were [[Retroactive continuity|retcon]]ed as part of the campaign.<ref name="The Hunt Within: Valance's Tale: Conclusion">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=swminis/article/huntwithin5|text=The Hunt Within: Valance's Tale: Conclusion|int=The Hunt Within: Valance's Tale: Conclusion}}</ref> Most of these sources likely placed this campaign during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' then put those battles on its "Flashpoints of the Galactic Civil War ([[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]—[[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]])" map. However, ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|cut content]] eventually stated this campaign occurred in 17 BBY.
